mapper.select: select id, resource_id, account_name, account_id, channel, status, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user, final_channel from voc_ms_be.ins_account_lexicon where status="Enabled"

WITH
global_avg AS ( SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) / DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), #{yearStartTime}), 2) AS year_total_avg, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.publish_time >= #{monthStartTime} THEN a.id END) / DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), #{monthStartTime}), 2) AS month_total_avg,
ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT a.one_id) / DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), #{yearStartTime}), 2) AS year_user_avg, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.publish_time >= #{monthStartTime} THEN a.one_id END) / DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), #{monthStartTime}), 2) AS month_user_avg,
ROUND( (SUM(CASE WHEN a.publish_time >= #{yearStartTime} AND a.sentiment = '负面' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN a.publish_time >= #{yearStartTime} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) * 100, 2 ) AS year_neg_avg,
ROUND( (SUM(CASE WHEN a.publish_time >= #{monthStartTime} AND a.sentiment = '负面' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN a.publish_time >= #{monthStartTime} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) * 100, 2 ) AS month_neg_avg,
ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT a.data_id) / DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), #{yearStartTime}), 2) AS year_voice_avg, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.publish_time >= #{monthStartTime} THEN a.data_id END) / DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), #{monthStartTime}), 2) AS month_voice_avg
FROM voc_sentiment_annotations_results_v a
WHERE a.publish_time >= #{yearStartTime} AND a.publish_time <= CURDATE()
),
valid_ids AS ( SELECT DISTINCT a.id FROM voc_sentiment_annotations_results_v a
WHERE ( (publish_time >= #{startTime} AND publish_time <= #{endTime}) OR (publish_time >= #{prevStartTime} AND publish_time <= #{prevEndTime}) OR (publish_time >= #{prevPrevStartTime} AND publish_time <= #{prevPrevEndTime}) OR (publish_time >= #{lastYearStartTime} AND publish_time <= #{lastYearEndTime}) OR (publish_time >= #{lastLastYearStartTime} AND publish_time <= #{lastLastYearEndTime}) )
),
curr_top AS ( SELECT array_agg(${groupField}) AS curr_top_list FROM ( SELECT ${groupField}, COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) AS topic_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) DESC) AS topRank FROM voc_sentiment_annotations_results_v a
WHERE a.publish_time >= #{startTime} AND a.publish_time <= #{endTime}
GROUP BY ${groupField} ) t WHERE 1=1
AND ${topCurrentWhere}
),
prev_top AS ( SELECT array_agg(${groupField}) AS prev_top_list FROM ( SELECT ${groupField}, COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) AS topic_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) DESC) AS topRank FROM voc_sentiment_annotations_results_v a
WHERE a.publish_time >= #{prevStartTime} AND a.publish_time <= #{prevEndTime}
GROUP BY ${groupField} ) t WHERE 1=1
AND ${topPreviousWhere}
),
period_data AS (
SELECT 'curr' AS tag, car_series_name, channel_code, dom_tag_first_code, dom_tag_second_code, dom_tag_three_code, dom_tag_four_code, topic, array_agg(id) as idList, COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS total, COUNT(DISTINCT data_id) AS voiceCount, ROUND(IFNULL((SUM(sentiment = '负面') / COUNT(*)) * 100, 0), 2) AS negativeRate, COUNT(DISTINCT one_id) AS usercount FROM voc_sentiment_annotations_results_v WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM valid_ids) AND publish_time >= #{startTime} AND publish_time <= #{endTime} GROUP BY
UNION ALL
SELECT 'prev' AS tag, car_series_name, channel_code, dom_tag_first_code, dom_tag_second_code, dom_tag_three_code, dom_tag_four_code, topic, array_agg(id) as idList, COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS total, COUNT(DISTINCT data_id) AS voiceCount, ROUND(IFNULL((SUM(sentiment = '负面') / COUNT(*)) * 100, 0), 2) AS negativeRate, COUNT(DISTINCT one_id) AS usercount FROM voc_sentiment_annotations_results_v WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM valid_ids) AND publish_time >= #{prevStartTime} AND publish_time <= #{prevEndTime} GROUP BY
UNION ALL
SELECT 'prev_prev' AS tag, car_series_name, channel_code, dom_tag_first_code, dom_tag_second_code, dom_tag_three_code, dom_tag_four_code, topic, array_agg(id) as idList, COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS total, COUNT(DISTINCT data_id) AS voiceCount, ROUND(IFNULL((SUM(sentiment = '负面') / COUNT(*)) * 100, 0), 2) AS negativeRate, COUNT(DISTINCT one_id) AS usercount FROM voc_sentiment_annotations_results_v WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM valid_ids) AND publish_time >= #{prevPrevStartTime} AND publish_time <= #{prevPrevEndTime} GROUP BY
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ly' AS tag, car_series_name, channel_code, dom_tag_first_code, dom_tag_second_code, dom_tag_three_code, dom_tag_four_code, topic, array_agg(id) as idList, COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS total, COUNT(DISTINCT data_id) AS voiceCount, ROUND(IFNULL((SUM(sentiment = '负面') / COUNT(*)) * 100, 0), 2) AS negativeRate, COUNT(DISTINCT one_id) AS usercount FROM voc_sentiment_annotations_results_v WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM valid_ids) AND publish_time >= #{lastYearStartTime} AND publish_time <= #{lastYearEndTime} GROUP BY
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ly_prev' AS tag, car_series_name, channel_code, dom_tag_first_code, dom_tag_second_code, dom_tag_three_code, dom_tag_four_code, topic, array_agg(id) as idList, COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS total, COUNT(DISTINCT data_id) AS voiceCount, ROUND(IFNULL((SUM(sentiment = '负面') / COUNT(*)) * 100, 0), 2) AS negativeRate, COUNT(DISTINCT one_id) AS usercount FROM voc_sentiment_annotations_results_v WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM valid_ids) AND publish_time >= #{lastLastYearStartTime} AND publish_time <= #{lastLastYearEndTime} GROUP BY )
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT curr.car_series_name, curr.channel_code, curr.dom_tag_first_code, curr.dom_tag_second_code, curr.dom_tag_three_code, curr.dom_tag_four_code, curr.topic,
curr.total AS curr_total, curr.voiceCount AS curr_voiceCount, curr.negativeRate AS curr_negativeRate, curr.usercount AS curr_usercount, curr.idList AS curr_idList,
ROUND(curr.total / CASE #{avgDayType} WHEN 'daily' THEN 1 WHEN 'weekly' THEN 7 WHEN 'monthly' THEN 30 ELSE 1 END, 2) AS curr_total_avg, ROUND(curr.voiceCount / CASE #{avgDayType} WHEN 'daily' THEN 1 WHEN 'weekly' THEN 7 WHEN 'monthly' THEN 30 ELSE 1 END, 2) AS curr_voiceCount_avg, curr.negativeRate as curr_negativeRate_avg, ROUND(curr.usercount / CASE #{avgDayType} WHEN 'daily' THEN 1 WHEN 'weekly' THEN 7 WHEN 'monthly' THEN 30 ELSE 1 END, 2) AS curr_usercount_avg,
prev.total AS prev_total, prev.voiceCount AS prev_voiceCount, prev.negativeRate AS prev_negativeRate, prev.usercount AS prev_usercount,
prev_prev.total AS prev_prev_total, prev_prev.voiceCount AS prev_prev_voiceCount, prev_prev.negativeRate AS prev_prev_negativeRate, prev_prev.usercount AS prev_prev_usercount,
ly.total AS ly_total, ly.voiceCount AS ly_voiceCount, ly.negativeRate AS ly_negativeRate, ly.usercount AS ly_usercount,
ly_prev.total AS ly_prev_total, ly_prev.voiceCount AS ly_prev_voiceCount, ly_prev.negativeRate AS ly_prev_negativeRate, ly_prev.usercount AS ly_prev_usercount,
g.year_total_avg, g.year_user_avg, g.year_voice_avg, g.year_neg_avg,
g.month_total_avg, g.month_user_avg, g.month_voice_avg, g.month_neg_avg,
ct.curr_top_list, CASE WHEN array_contains(ct.curr_top_list, curr.${groupField}) THEN '是' ELSE '否' END AS is_curr_top,
pt.prev_top_list, CASE WHEN array_contains(pt.prev_top_list, curr.${groupField}) THEN '是' ELSE '否' END AS is_prev_top,
ROUND((curr.total-prev.total)/NULLIF(prev.total,0)*100,2) AS curr_total_mom, ROUND((curr.voiceCount-prev.voiceCount)/NULLIF(prev.voiceCount,0)*100,2) AS curr_voice_mom, ROUND(curr.negativeRate-prev.negativeRate,2) AS curr_neg_mom, ROUND((curr.usercount-prev.usercount)/NULLIF(prev.usercount,0)*100,2) AS curr_user_mom,
ROUND((curr.total-ly.total)/NULLIF(ly.total,0)*100,2) AS curr_total_yoy, ROUND((curr.voiceCount-ly.voiceCount)/NULLIF(ly.voiceCount,0)*100,2) AS curr_voice_yoy, ROUND(curr.negativeRate-ly.negativeRate,2) AS curr_neg_yoy, ROUND((curr.usercount-ly.usercount)/NULLIF(ly.usercount,0)*100,2) AS curr_user_yoy,
ROUND((prev.total-prev_prev.total)/NULLIF(prev_prev.total,0)*100,2) AS prev_total_mom, ROUND((prev.voiceCount-prev_prev.voiceCount)/NULLIF(prev_prev.voiceCount,0)*100,2) AS prev_voice_mom, ROUND(prev.negativeRate-prev_prev.negativeRate,2) AS prev_neg_mom, ROUND((prev.usercount-prev_prev.usercount)/NULLIF(prev_prev.usercount,0)*100,2) AS prev_user_mom,
ROUND((prev.total-ly_prev.total)/NULLIF(ly_prev.total,0)*100,2) AS prev_total_yoy, ROUND((prev.voiceCount-ly_prev.voiceCount)/NULLIF(ly_prev.voiceCount,0)*100,2) AS prev_voice_yoy, ROUND(prev.negativeRate-ly_prev.negativeRate,2) AS prev_neg_yoy, ROUND((prev.usercount-ly_prev.usercount)/NULLIF(ly_prev.usercount,0)*100,2) AS prev_user_yoy
FROM period_data curr CROSS JOIN global_avg g
CROSS JOIN curr_top ct
CROSS JOIN prev_top pt
LEFT JOIN period_data prev ON 1=1 AND curr.car_series_name = prev.car_series_name AND curr.channel_code = prev.channel_code AND curr.dom_tag_first_code = prev.dom_tag_first_code AND curr.dom_tag_second_code = prev.dom_tag_second_code AND curr.dom_tag_three_code = prev.dom_tag_three_code AND curr.dom_tag_four_code = prev.dom_tag_four_code AND curr.topic = prev.topic AND prev.tag = 'prev'
LEFT JOIN period_data prev_prev ON 1=1 AND curr.car_series_name = prev_prev.car_series_name AND curr.channel_code = prev_prev.channel_code AND curr.dom_tag_first_code = prev_prev.dom_tag_first_code AND curr.dom_tag_second_code = prev_prev.dom_tag_second_code AND curr.dom_tag_three_code = prev_prev.dom_tag_three_code AND curr.dom_tag_four_code = prev_prev.dom_tag_four_code AND curr.topic = prev_prev.topic AND prev_prev.tag = 'prev_prev'
LEFT JOIN period_data ly ON 1=1 AND curr.car_series_name = ly.car_series_name AND curr.channel_code = ly.channel_code AND curr.dom_tag_first_code = ly.dom_tag_first_code AND curr.dom_tag_second_code = ly.dom_tag_second_code AND curr.dom_tag_three_code = ly.dom_tag_three_code AND curr.dom_tag_four_code = ly.dom_tag_four_code AND curr.topic = ly.topic AND ly.tag = 'ly'
LEFT JOIN period_data ly_prev ON 1=1 AND curr.car_series_name = ly_prev.car_series_name AND curr.channel_code = ly_prev.channel_code AND curr.dom_tag_first_code = ly_prev.dom_tag_first_code AND curr.dom_tag_second_code = ly_prev.dom_tag_second_code AND curr.dom_tag_three_code = ly_prev.dom_tag_three_code AND curr.dom_tag_four_code = ly_prev.dom_tag_four_code AND curr.topic = ly_prev.topic AND ly_prev.tag = 'ly_prev'
WHERE curr.tag = 'curr' ) t
${whereClause}
${logicOperator} is_curr_top='是'
${logicOperator} is_prev_top='是'

when.test: groupByCarSeries or groupByChannel or groupField != null
